description: Genuine slow memory growth ending in an OOM kill. The mirror image of disk_full: here the memory really is the cause.

timeline.message: heap usage 1.6GB of 2.0GB after full GC, up from 900MB at 21:00
GC pause 1400ms, old gen not reclaiming
heap usage 1.9GB of 2.0GB after full GC

ground_truth.root_cause: An unbounded embedding cache in recommendation-service grows without eviction, reaching 4.8 million entries. Old-generation heap is not reclaimed across full GCs, so the process exhausts its 2GB heap and is OOM killed.
must_not_conclude: traffic spike is the root cause
ground_truth.distractor_note: Requires distinguishing a real leak from the disk_full case, where memory growth was a symptom.
